base_member_text: Header @L12 declares output 'spectrum_random_phase.txt' but the script writes 'spectrum_two_components.txt' @L88 — name mismatch between documentation and code
audit_member_text: The header documents spectrum_random_phase.txt at line 12, while the actual output is spectrum_two_components.txt at line 88; downstream instructions using the documented name will not find the produced file.

base_member_text: angle (SPC_angle.txt @L29) and Eng1 @L95, lambda @L59, Knm @L71, omega_nm @L61, fre_used/spc_used @L74-L75, Hrms/Hsig/E (L123-L126) are computed but never used in the written output; MATLAB built-in name 'angle' is shadowed
audit_member_text: Eng1, lambda, Knm, OMEGA_nm, fre_used, and spc_used are computed at lines 59, 71-75, and 95 but never consumed; in particular Eng1 is not the quantity written, so the output contains amplitudes despite a separately constructed energy representation.

base_member_text: IGW_each @L116 adds freq_low (a frequency) directly inside the cosine phase argument (OMEGA_nm_low.*time+freq_low+phase_low) — dimensionally inconsistent with the wave synthesis at L114/L119 which use phase only; likely affects only the diagnostic plot, not the written output

Element-wise products like Amp_each.*cos(Omega_each.*time+Phi_each) @L114 multiply column vectors by the row vector time — relies on MATLAB implicit expansion (R2016b+); Wave_total=sum(Wave_each) @L115 then sums over components only if the orientation matches; IGW_total=IGW_each @L117 is not summed at all (single pair case)

The written file mixes fprintf-formatted header/Freq/Dire lines with dlmwrite '-append' data (L98-L104) while fid is still open — fclose happens after dlmwrite @L106; ordering correctness relies on OS-level append semantics
wvnum_omvec is required but absent from this file; the direction file value is not written (Dire hardcoded 0.0 @L93)

audit_member_text: The script explicitly loads SPC_angle.txt at line 29 but never uses angle; it hard-codes Dire=0.0 at line 93. Thus the advertised single input angle at line 9 is silently discarded from the generated FUNWAVE spectrum.

The plotted IG reconstruction adds freq_low directly as a phase term at line 116, whereas the generated-file reconstruction at line 119 uses only Phase1 and the exported IG phases at lines 96 and 104 contain phase_low without freq_low. The diagnostic blue IG trace therefore does not represent the spectral file that the script writes.

The Dnm expression divides by omega(1)*omega(2) and by g*knm*tanh(knm*h)-(omega(1)-omega(2))^2 at lines 64-66 without checking zero-frequency inputs, duplicate frequencies (knm=fnm=0), or a difference-frequency free-wave resonance. A zero or near-zero denominator propagates Inf/NaN into anm at line 68 and the output at line 103.
